201.translation: 我們已經順利朝著按時完成的方向前進，但在達成之前請繼續努力工作。
skeleton: We are well on our way to meeting this deadline｜主句
but please carry on working hard｜祈使句
until we get there｜時間
grammar: be on one’s way to + N／V-ing＝正朝著……前進。
carry on + V-ing＝繼續做……。
until + 子句＝直到……為止。
collocations: be on one’s way to＝正朝……前進

example.en: Please carry on working until the task is complete.
example.zh: 請繼續工作直到任務完成。

202.translation: 坦白說，我從來不太看好 Chase 當專案經理；他實在太沒有組織能力了。
skeleton: To be perfectly frank｜插入語
I’d never thought much of Chase as a project manager｜主句
he’s much too disorganized｜原因補充
grammar: to be frank＝坦白說，是固定片語。
think much of + 人／事＝高度評價……；never thought much of＝一直不太看好。
much too + 形容詞＝實在太……。

vocab.usage: disorganized manager＝缺乏組織能力的主管

example.en: To be perfectly frank, the plan needs more work.
example.zh: 坦白說，這個計畫還需要更多改進。

203.translation: 雖然 Mike 一生中面對過許多挑戰，但他總能設法挺過來。
skeleton: Although he had faced many challenges｜讓步子句
Mike always managed to pull through｜主句
grammar: Although + 子句＝雖然……。
manage to + V＝設法成功做到……。
pull through＝挺過困境／康復。

vocab.usage: pull through a crisis＝度過危機

example.en: She managed to pull through a very difficult year.
example.zh: 她設法挺過了非常艱難的一年。

204.translation: Mets 擊出全壘打時，全場觀眾陷入瘋狂；這是 Josh Edgin 本場比賽的第二支全壘打！
skeleton: the crowd goes wild｜固定搭配
as the Mets score a home run｜同時事件
the second in this game｜補充
grammar: go + 形容詞可表示「變得……」；go wild＝陷入瘋狂／非常興奮。
as 可表示「當……時」。
score a home run＝擊出／得到全壘打。

vocab.usage: the crowd went wild＝觀眾沸騰
hit/score a home run＝擊出全壘打

collocations: score a home run＝擊出全壘打

example.en: The crowd went wild when the team scored.
example.zh: 球隊得分時，全場觀眾都沸騰了。

205.translation: Jesse 一直覺得自己很幸運，因為多年來所有老闆和主管都很公平，也很好相處。
skeleton: Jesse had always felt very fortunate｜主句
that all his bosses and supervisors ... had been fair and pleasant｜內容子句
to work for｜修飾 pleasant
grammar: feel fortunate that...＝覺得很幸運……。
had always felt / had been 使用過去完成式，配合過去敘事。
pleasant to work for＝為其工作很愉快。
collocations: fair and pleasant＝公平且好相處

example.en: I feel fortunate to work with such supportive managers.
example.zh: 能和這麼支持員工的主管共事，我覺得很幸運。

206.translation: 今天下午雨下得太大，我從窗戶幾乎看不到花園。
skeleton: It was raining so hard｜原因
that I could barely see our garden｜so...that 結果
from the window｜視角
grammar: so + 副詞／形容詞 + that＝如此……以至於……。
barely＝幾乎不，帶否定意味。
could + 原形動詞 see。

example.en: The fog was so thick that we could barely see the road.
example.zh: 霧太濃了，我們幾乎看不到道路。

207.translation: Angela 有時說話會很直接，但我向你保證她沒有惡意。
skeleton: Angela can be very direct at times｜主句一
but I assure you｜轉折
she means well｜受詞子句
grammar: at times＝有時候。
assure + 人 + (that) 子句＝向某人保證。
mean well＝出於好意、沒有惡意。

vocab.usage: I know you mean well.＝我知道你是好意

example.en: He can sound blunt at times, but he means well.
example.zh: 他有時聽起來很直白，但其實是好意。

208.translation: 在匆忙下結論之前，我們何不停下來仔細考慮事實？
skeleton: Why don’t we pause｜建議
and consider the facts carefully｜並列動詞
before jumping to any conclusions｜時間／前置條件
grammar: Why don’t we + V...?＝我們何不……？
pause and consider 為平行動詞。
before + V-ing＝在做……之前。
jump to conclusions＝草率下結論。

example.en: Please consider all the facts before making a decision.
example.zh: 做決定前請考慮所有事實。

209.translation: 難道要求有人哪怕一次，在看到我懷孕的太太時讓出座位，也算要求太多嗎？
skeleton: Is it too much to ask｜問句
that just for once someone would give up their seat｜內容子句
when they see my pregnant wife｜時間
grammar: give up one’s seat＝讓座。
for once＝至少這一次、難得一次。
too much to ask＝要求太多。
would + 原形動詞。

vocab.usage: give up a seat for someone＝為某人讓座

options.label: B
options.usage: give in to pressure＝向壓力屈服

collocations: too much to ask＝要求太多

example.en: He gave up his seat to an elderly passenger.
example.zh: 他把座位讓給一位年長乘客。

210.translation: 我知道你對做這個決定感到不確定，但已經沒有時間可以浪費了。
skeleton: I know you feel uncertain｜主句
about making this decision｜介系詞＋動名詞
but there is no time to waste｜轉折
grammar: feel uncertain about + N／V-ing＝對……感到不確定。
there is no time to + V＝沒有時間做……。
waste time＝浪費時間。
collocations: there is no time to waste＝沒有時間可浪費

example.en: There is no time to waste if we want to meet the deadline.
example.zh: 如果要如期完成，就沒有時間可以浪費。

211.translation: Fred 一走進辦公室，就感覺有些不對勁。
skeleton: From the moment he walked in｜時間
Fred felt｜主句
something was amiss in the office｜受詞子句
grammar: from the moment + 子句＝從……那一刻起。
amiss 作形容詞＝不對勁的、出問題的。
feel (that) + 子句＝感覺……。

vocab.usage: walk into the office＝走進辦公室

example.en: I knew immediately that something was amiss.
example.zh: 我立刻知道有些不對勁。

212.translation: 實驗與臨床證據都顯示，新藥讓研究中的病患有非凡的康復速度。
skeleton: Both experimental and clinical evidence｜主詞
showed that｜主句
the new drug resulted in an extraordinary rate of recovery｜受詞子句
for the patients involved in the study｜對象
grammar: both A and B＝A 與 B 兩者都……。
result in + N＝導致……。
an extraordinary rate of recovery＝非凡的康復速度。
involved in the study 是過去分詞片語修飾 patients。

vocab.usage: clinical evidence shows＝臨床證據顯示

collocations: experimental and clinical evidence＝實驗與臨床證據

example.en: The treatment resulted in an extraordinary rate of recovery.
example.zh: 這項治療帶來了非常高的康復速度。

213.translation: 教授對那群聽眾發表了一場多麼鼓舞人心、又充滿幽默感的演講啊！
skeleton: What an inspiring lecture｜感嘆句受詞
the professor delivered｜主詞＋動詞
to that audience｜對象
and with such a sense of humor｜補充
grammar: What + a/an + adj. + 單數名詞 + 主詞 + 動詞！＝多麼……啊！
deliver a lecture＝發表演講／授課。
a sense of humor＝幽默感。

options.label: D
options.usage: bombard someone with questions＝連番提問

example.en: She delivered an inspiring lecture to the students.
example.zh: 她向學生發表了一場鼓舞人心的演講。

214.translation: 我還沒習慣新家，每天早上睜開眼睛時仍會覺得驚訝。
skeleton: I haven’t gotten used to our new home｜現在完成式
and still feel surprised｜並列
when I open my eyes in the morning｜時間
grammar: get used to + N／V-ing＝習慣……。
feel + 形容詞＝感到……。
surprised 形容人的感受；surprising 形容造成驚訝的事物。

vocab.usage: get used to a new job＝習慣新工作

example.en: It took me a while to get used to the new office.
example.zh: 我花了一段時間才習慣新辦公室。

215.translation: 第一家 Starbucks 店一受歡迎後，分店就開始在城裡到處冒出來。
skeleton: As soon as the first Starbucks store became popular｜時間子句
they started springing up｜主句
all over town｜地點
grammar: as soon as + 子句＝一……就……。
start + V-ing＝開始做……。
spring up＝迅速出現、如雨後春筍般冒出。

vocab.usage: shops sprang up＝商店紛紛出現
stores all over town＝全城的商店

options.label: D
options.usage: something along the lines of＝類似……

example.en: New cafés began springing up as soon as the area became popular.
example.zh: 這一帶一受歡迎，新咖啡店就紛紛出現。

215.sourceNote: 原教材題號印成 274，系統已依題目順序校正為第 215 題。

216.translation: 很明顯 Kevin 不想加入球隊，只是覺得自己沒有選擇。
skeleton: It was obvious｜形式主詞
that Kevin didn't want to be on the team｜真正主詞子句
but felt that he had no choice｜轉折
grammar: It is/was obvious that...＝很明顯……。
want to + V＝想要做。
have no choice＝別無選擇。

vocab.usage: have no choice but to + V＝只好做

collocations: be on the team＝加入球隊

example.en: It was obvious that he did not want the position.
example.zh: 很明顯他不想要那個職位。

217.translation: 你已經有很好的基礎，我建議你報名中級甚至高級課程。
skeleton: I would recommend｜主句
you sign up for an intermediate or even an advanced course｜受詞內容
as you already have a strong foundation｜原因
grammar: recommend + 人 + 原形動詞（美式用法）＝建議某人做……。
sign up for + 課程＝報名……。
intermediate＝中級的；advanced＝進階的。
as 可表示「因為」。

vocab.usage: sign up for a course＝報名課程

collocations: sign up for a course＝報名課程

example.en: Students with a strong foundation may take the intermediate course.
example.zh: 基礎扎實的學生可以修中級課程。

218.translation: 不好意思，你也正要前往市中心嗎？也許我們可以一起搭計程車。
skeleton: are you also headed to the city center?｜問句
Perhaps we could share a cab｜建議
grammar: be headed to + 地點＝正前往……。
could 可用於較委婉的建議。
share a cab＝共乘計程車。

vocab.usage: be headed to the airport＝正前往機場

example.en: Are you headed to the airport too?
example.zh: 你也正要去機場嗎？

219.translation: 列出優缺點圖表後，該做什麼決定就變得非常清楚了。
skeleton: After drawing up a chart of pros and cons｜時間
the decision became crystal clear｜主句
grammar: draw up + 文件／表格＝擬定、製作。
pros and cons＝優點與缺點。
crystal clear＝非常清楚、清晰明瞭。
become + 形容詞＝變得……。

vocab.usage: weigh the pros and cons＝權衡利弊
make something crystal clear＝講得非常清楚

collocations: draw up a chart＝製作圖表

example.en: After reviewing the data, the best choice became crystal clear.
example.zh: 檢視資料後，最佳選擇變得非常明確。

220.translation: 喔，我沒發現你還在處理那份報告。沒關係，我晚點再回來。
skeleton: I didn’t realize｜主句
you were still working on that report｜受詞子句
Never mind｜轉折回應
I’ll come back later｜未來
grammar: realize + 子句＝察覺、知道……。
work on + N＝處理、從事……。
Never mind＝沒關係／算了。
will + 原形動詞表示未來。

vocab.usage: work on a report＝處理報告

collocations: work on a report＝處理報告

example.en: Never mind, I'll ask you again later.
example.zh: 沒關係，我晚點再問你。

221.translation: Cinemaxx Cinema 非常重視隱私，因此人員留任率極高。
skeleton: Privacy is especially valued here｜主句
so the retention rate is extremely high｜結果
grammar: especially 是副詞，修飾 valued。
be valued＝受到重視。
retention rate＝留任率／保留率。
原題 The privacy 在一般抽象概念中較自然寫 Privacy。
collocations: be highly/especially valued＝受到高度／特別重視

example.en: Employee privacy is especially valued at this company.
example.zh: 這家公司特別重視員工隱私。

221.sourceNote: 抽象概念 privacy 通常不加 the；較自然為 Privacy is especially valued here。

222.translation: 副總裁以前曾是軍方飛行員，這是個很少人知道的事實。
skeleton: It’s a little-known fact｜主句
about the vice president｜主題
that he used to be a military pilot｜同位語子句
grammar: little-known + 名詞＝鮮為人知的……。
fact that + 子句＝……這項事實。
used to + V＝過去曾經……。

vocab.usage: former military pilot＝前軍方飛行員

options.label: A
options.usage: a little-known fact＝鮮為人知的事實

example.en: It is a little-known fact that the CEO once worked as a teacher.
example.zh: 很少人知道執行長以前曾當過老師。

223.translation: 買車時，可以把那套汽車音響當作贈品包含在內嗎？
skeleton: Could I have that car stereo included｜使役結構
as a gift｜作為贈品
with the purchase of a vehicle｜購買條件
grammar: have + 受詞 + p.p.＝讓某物被……／使某事完成。
have that car stereo included＝讓汽車音響被包含進去。
with the purchase of＝購買……時。

vocab.usage: install a car stereo＝安裝汽車音響
free gift with the purchase of＝購買即贈

options.label: C
options.usage: have something included＝讓某物包含在內

example.en: Can I have delivery included with the purchase?
example.zh: 購買時可以把配送包含在內嗎？

224.translation: 多數應屆畢業生需要一封高度讚賞的推薦信，但他們仍得設法和其他競爭者做出區隔。
skeleton: A glowing recommendation｜主詞
is what most recent graduates need｜主句
but they still have to differentiate themselves｜轉折
from other competitors｜比較對象
grammar: glowing recommendation＝高度讚揚的推薦。
what ... need 是名詞子句作主詞補語。
differentiate oneself from + 人／物＝讓自己與……有所區別。

vocab.usage: recent college graduate＝大學應屆畢業生

collocations: differentiate oneself from＝讓自己與……有別

example.en: A strong recommendation can help a graduate stand out.
example.zh: 強力的推薦可以幫助畢業生脫穎而出。

225.translation: Uni Chemistry Lab 的研究人員擔心，最新商品的發售日期會因衛生主管機關檢出的殘留物而延後。
skeleton: Researchers ... are now worrying｜主句
that the release date ... will be postponed｜受詞子句
because of residues detected by the Health Bureau｜原因
grammar: worry that + 子句＝擔心……。
will be postponed 是未來式被動。
because of + 名詞＝因為……。
detected by... 是過去分詞片語，修飾 residues。

example.en: The product launch was postponed after chemical residues were detected.
example.zh: 檢出化學殘留物後，產品上市被延後。

225.sourceNote: 原題 released date 應為 release date。

226.translation: 儘管 Ann 外表亮眼、作品集也由知名攝影師拍攝，但她在試鏡時不協調的動作讓她失去競賽席位。
skeleton: Despite the fact that Ann has ...｜讓步
her uncoordinated movement at the go-see｜主詞
costs her a place in the competition｜結果
grammar: despite the fact that + 子句＝儘管……。
uncoordinated 修飾 movement＝不協調的動作。
cost + 人 + 物＝使某人失去／付出某物。
collocations: cost someone a place＝讓某人失去名額

example.en: One mistake cost him a place in the final.
example.zh: 一次失誤讓他失去了決賽名額。

227.translation: 新系列服裝幫助這個時尚品牌超越了前一年度的銷售水準。
skeleton: The new range of clothes｜主詞
helped the fashion brand exceed｜使役／幫助
the sales levels of the previous year｜受詞
grammar: help + 人／物 + (to) V＝幫助……做。
exceed + 數字／標準＝超過。
previous year＝前一年。

vocab.usage: new range of products＝新系列產品
sales levels increased＝銷售水準提高

collocations: exceed sales levels＝超越銷售水準

example.en: This year's sales exceeded those of the previous year.
example.zh: 今年的銷售超過了前一年。

228.translation: 雖然這名按摩師的惡名在附近早已廣為人知，但前來此地的旅客仍被蒙在鼓裡。
skeleton: Although the notoriety of the masseur has been widely known｜讓步
tourists traveling here｜主詞＋分詞
are still kept in the dark｜被動慣用語
grammar: notoriety＝惡名、壞名聲，通常帶負面語氣。
be kept in the dark＝被蒙在鼓裡。
traveling here 是現在分詞片語修飾 tourists。

vocab.usage: be kept in the dark＝被蒙在鼓裡

collocations: be kept in the dark＝被蒙在鼓裡

example.en: The company gained notoriety for poor customer service.
example.zh: 這家公司因糟糕的客服而聲名狼藉。

229.translation: 根據一位暢銷書作者的說法，「履歷就只是清單，而清單不吸引人」，所以你仍需要經營自己的個性與其他特質。
skeleton: According to an author of the bestsellers｜消息來源
resumes are just lists｜引語
and lists are not compelling｜並列
so you still need to work on your personality｜結果
grammar: resume＝履歷。
compelling＝有吸引力、令人信服的。
work on + N＝努力改善／處理……。
according to + 人／來源＝根據……。
collocations: work on one’s personality＝培養／改善個性

example.en: A resume lists your experience, but your personality also matters.
example.zh: 履歷列出經歷，但個性同樣重要。

230.translation: 在聯邦探員監控下轉移資金並不容易，因此 Mark 搭私人飛機前往偏遠島嶼，和其他政府官員進一步討論細節。
skeleton: Moving the money under the watch of federal agents｜動名詞片語主詞
was not easy｜主句
so Mark took a private jet｜結果
to discuss further details with other government officials｜目的
grammar: Moving... 是動名詞片語作主詞。
under the watch of＝在……監視／監督下。
to discuss... 是目的不定詞。
government official＝政府官員。

vocab.usage: federal law-enforcement agent＝聯邦執法人員

collocations: under the watch of＝在……監控下

example.en: Government officials met to discuss further details.
example.zh: 政府官員會面以進一步討論細節。

231.translation: Alia 知道要哥哥幫忙這件事根本不可能。
skeleton: Alia knew｜主句
asking her brother to help with the work｜動名詞主詞
was out of the question｜補語
grammar: ask + 人 + to + V＝要求／請某人做……。
out of the question＝不可能、免談。
動名詞片語 asking... 作受詞子句中的主詞。

vocab.usage: That’s out of the question.＝那不可能
help with the work＝幫忙工作

options.label: A
options.usage: out of this world＝好得不得了

example.en: Canceling the project is out of the question.
example.zh: 取消這個專案是不可能的。

232.translation: Cindy 失去了 401(k) 退休金，又無法從雇主取得遣散費，因此暫時搬回家和父母住。
skeleton: Since Cindy lost her 401k｜原因
and could not get the severance pay from her employer｜並列原因
she moved back home｜主句
for the time being｜暫時
grammar: severance pay＝遣散費。
since 可表示「因為」。
move back home＝搬回家。
for the time being＝暫時。

vocab.usage: stay here for the time being＝暫時待在這

example.en: Employees affected by the closure will receive severance pay.
example.zh: 受關閉影響的員工將獲得遣散費。

233.translation: 這座新飯店綜合設施針對三月底前收到的預訂，提供特別企業團體優惠價。
skeleton: The new hotel complex｜主詞
offers special corporate group rates｜動詞＋受詞
for reservations received before the end of March｜條件
grammar: offer + 受詞＝提供……。
group rate＝團體優惠價。
received before... 是過去分詞片語，修飾 reservations。
collocations: corporate group rates＝企業團體優惠價
before the end of＝在……月底前

example.en: The hotel offers discounted group rates for corporate clients.
example.zh: 飯店為企業客戶提供團體折扣價。

234.translation: 有人收到行銷部門關於春季系列配色方案的消息了嗎？
skeleton: Has anyone heard from the marketing department｜問句
regarding the color scheme｜主題
for the spring collection｜適用系列
grammar: hear from + 人／部門＝收到……的消息。
regarding + N＝關於……。
color scheme＝配色方案，是固定搭配。

example.en: The design team approved the new color scheme.
example.zh: 設計團隊核准了新的配色方案。

235.translation: 總共有 92 個貨櫃正從亞洲港口運往英國、法國和比利時。
skeleton: Altogether 92 containers｜主詞
are being shipped｜現在進行式被動
from the Asian port｜起點
to England, France and Belgium｜目的地
grammar: are being + p.p.＝現在進行式被動，表示正在被……。
ship + 貨物＝運送。
altogether＝總共。

vocab.usage: ship goods overseas＝將貨物運往海外

collocations: be shipped from A to B＝從A運往B

example.en: The goods are being shipped from Taiwan to Europe.
example.zh: 貨物正從台灣運往歐洲。

236.translation: 繼續購買前，請閱讀並同意這些條款與條件。
skeleton: Please read and agree to｜祈使句
the terms and conditions｜受詞
before continuing with your purchase｜時間
grammar: terms and conditions＝條款與條件，是固定法律／商務用語。
agree to + 名詞＝同意……。
before + V-ing＝在做……之前。

vocab.usage: agree to the terms and conditions＝同意條款

example.en: Please agree to the terms and conditions before proceeding.
example.zh: 繼續前請先同意條款與條件。

237.translation: 從顧客角度來看，設計只有在對使用者友善且直覺時才算成功。
skeleton: From the customer’s point of view｜觀點
a design only works｜主句
if it’s user-friendly and intuitive｜條件
grammar: from one’s point of view＝從某人的觀點來看。
user-friendly＝使用者友善的。
if + 子句＝如果……。
friendly 作複合形容詞後綴時常寫 user-friendly。

vocab.usage: from the customer’s point of view＝從顧客角度

example.en: Customers prefer a user-friendly and intuitive interface.
example.zh: 顧客偏好使用者友善且直覺的介面。

238.translation: 這份問卷約需半小時完成，並由三個部分組成。
skeleton: The survey will take approximately half an hour to complete｜主句一
and is composed of three parts｜主句二
grammar: take + 時間 + to + V＝做……需要多少時間。
be composed of＝由……組成。
approximately＝大約。

vocab.usage: be composed of three parts＝由三部分組成

collocations: take half an hour to + V＝花半小時做

example.en: The course is composed of three modules.
example.zh: 這門課由三個模組組成。

239.translation: 我的膝蓋上週開始痛，我擔心在陡峭山坡上下健行會使情況惡化。
skeleton: My knee started hurting last week｜主句一
and I'm afraid｜主句二
hiking up and down steep hills will aggravate it｜受詞子句
grammar: start + V-ing＝開始出現某動作／狀態。
be afraid + 子句＝擔心……。
動名詞片語 hiking... 作子句主詞。
aggravate＝使惡化、加重。

example.en: Running may aggravate your knee injury.
example.zh: 跑步可能會使你的膝傷惡化。

240.translation: 今天是特賣最後一天，所以如果你想享受優惠，就必須今天完成購買。
skeleton: This is the final day of the sale｜背景
so you’ll have to make your purchase today｜結果
if you’d like to take advantage of the savings｜條件
grammar: make a purchase＝購買、完成購買。
have to + V＝必須做。
take advantage of + N＝利用、享受……的好處。
savings 在促銷語境＝省下的金額／優惠。

vocab.usage: take advantage of a discount＝利用折扣

collocations: final day of the sale＝特賣最後一天

example.en: Make your purchase today to take advantage of the discount.
example.zh: 今天購買即可享受折扣。

241.translation: 一則廣告開始播放，內容是一名海盜尋找裝滿即食麵包裝的寶箱。
skeleton: A commercial came on｜主句
featuring a pirate hunting for a treasure chest｜現在分詞補充
that is filled with packages of instant noodles｜關係子句
grammar: feature + 人／物＝以……為特色、主打……。
featuring... 是現在分詞片語，修飾 commercial。
hunt for＝尋找。
be filled with＝裝滿……。

options.label: C
options.usage: featuring a celebrity＝由名人主演／主打名人

example.en: The advertisement features a famous actor.
example.zh: 這則廣告以一位知名演員為主角。

242.translation: 從第一眼就很明顯，David 感到極度不自在。
skeleton: It was quite apparent from the first glance｜形式主詞句
that David was feeling extremely uncomfortable｜真正主詞子句
grammar: It is apparent that...＝很明顯……。
extremely 是程度副詞，修飾 uncomfortable。
from the first glance＝從第一眼就……。

example.en: It was apparent that he felt extremely uncomfortable.
example.zh: 很明顯他感到非常不自在。

243.translation: 我們把 Matt 介紹給 Sally 吧。我有預感他們會很合得來。
skeleton: Let’s introduce Matt to Sally｜建議
I have a hunch｜主句
that they will get along very well｜同位語子句
grammar: introduce A to B＝把 A 介紹給 B。
have a hunch that...＝有預感……。
get along (with)＝相處融洽。

vocab.usage: get along with colleagues＝與同事相處融洽

options.label: A
options.usage: a drop in sales＝銷售下降

collocations: introduce A to B＝把A介紹給B

example.en: I have a hunch that the meeting will go well.
example.zh: 我有預感這場會議會很順利。

244.translation: 證人陳述完後，法庭內爆發出一陣驚呼。
skeleton: The courtroom｜主詞
erupted in exclamations of surprise｜動詞片語
after the witness finished her statement｜時間
grammar: erupt in/into + 名詞＝突然爆發出……。
exclamation of surprise＝驚呼。
finish + 名詞／V-ing＝完成……。

example.en: The audience erupted in applause.
example.zh: 觀眾爆發出掌聲。

245.translation: 雖然發生的事情不是 Bill 的錯，他仍然把這個情況怪到自己身上。
skeleton: Although what happened wasn’t Bill’s fault｜讓步
he still blamed himself｜主句
for the situation｜原因
grammar: blame + 人 + for + 事情＝因某事責怪某人。
blame oneself＝自責。
what happened 是名詞子句，作 Although 子句主詞。

vocab.usage: It’s not your fault.＝不是你的錯

example.en: She blamed herself for the mistake.
example.zh: 她因那個錯誤而自責。

246.translation: 這只是例行檢查，所以你明晚應該就能把車領回去。
skeleton: This is just a routine checkup｜主句
so you should be able to pick up your car｜結果
tomorrow evening｜時間
grammar: routine checkup＝例行檢查。
should be able to + V＝應該能夠做……。
pick up + 物＝取回／領取。

example.en: The vehicle only needs a routine checkup.
example.zh: 這輛車只需要例行檢查。

247.translation: 表演突然結束，而燈光沒有重新亮起時，觀眾開始不確定地鼓掌。
skeleton: The performance ended abruptly｜主句一
and the audience started to clap uncertainly｜主句二
when the lights didn’t come back on｜時間
grammar: abruptly＝突然地、唐突地，修飾 ended。
start to + V＝開始做。
come back on＝重新亮起／恢復供電。

example.en: The meeting ended abruptly after the argument.
example.zh: 爭執後，會議突然結束。

248.translation: 我們可以撥一部分預算購買新制服，因為目前的制服看起來相當破舊。
skeleton: We can allot a portion of the budget｜主句
for new uniforms｜用途
as the current ones look quite worn｜原因
grammar: allot + 資源 + for/to＝分配……給……。
a portion of the budget＝一部分預算。
ones 代替前面的複數名詞 uniforms。
worn＝磨損的、破舊的。

vocab.usage: a portion of the budget＝一部分預算

collocations: allot a portion of the budget＝撥一部分預算

example.en: The company allotted part of the budget for new uniforms.
example.zh: 公司撥出一部分預算購買新制服。

249.translation: 現在下結論還太早，但整體感覺是這場會議進行得非常順利。
skeleton: It’s too early to make conclusions｜主句
but the overall feeling is｜轉折
that the meeting went very well｜補語子句
grammar: too + adj. + to + V＝太……而不能／不適合做……。
make/draw conclusions＝下結論。
overall feeling＝整體感覺。
go well＝進行順利。
collocations: too early to + V＝現在做……太早

example.en: It's too early to draw conclusions from the data.
example.zh: 現在根據資料下結論還太早。

250.translation: 最後，被裁員反而成了一件好事，因為它迫使我自己創業，而從那之後我一直快樂得多。
skeleton: In the end｜最後
getting laid off was a blessing｜動名詞主詞
as it forced me to start my own business｜原因
and I’ve been much happier ever since｜結果
grammar: get laid off＝被裁員。
a blessing＝好事、福氣；語意近似 a blessing in disguise。
force + 人 + to + V＝迫使某人做……。
ever since＝從那之後一直，常搭現在完成式。

vocab.usage: a blessing in disguise＝因禍得福
have been ... ever since＝此後一直……

options.label: B
options.usage: a blessing in disguise＝因禍得福

collocations: start one’s own business＝自己創業

example.en: Losing that job turned out to be a blessing in disguise.
example.zh: 失去那份工作結果反而因禍得福。
